survival.Notes: SI Fig. S7a (caption mislabels panels): 100% survival in both PDT groups through the plotted period; saline control falls in 25% steps on days 12, 16, 19, 22 (0% from day 22), median about 16 days. Single i.v. dose 200 uL of 10 uM (2 nmol per mouse), xenon lamp 30 min at 24 and 48 h; no mg/kg. Medians: treated not reached (>22). Source: SI/10.1039_d0sc04751a.pdf | Fig. S7a, p. S9; main text Fig. 8.
